evidence: Paths the brief names exist and are staged. instruction.md:3 names '/instructions' ('the six notes') and '/assets/seed_data.json'; environment/instructions holds exactly six notes (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui) and environment/assets holds seed_data.json. environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets', and is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile. The only other /assets path in the public notes is integration.md:7 (same file). Cross-references between notes resolve: integration.md:5 -> security.md, policy.md:3 -> ui.md. task.toml:2 'artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]' matches the contract. Content matches what prompt, solution and judges assume. seed_data.json parses and is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."} (sha256 30cf9958..., equal to the manifest entry). That agrees with instruction.md:3 ('describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish') and integration.md:7 ('contains no user snippets or starter implementation'). The golden neither reads the seed nor pre-populates records: solve.sh only copies solution/app into /app, and the one startup INSERT in server.js:167 is 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO snippet_revisions ... SELECT ... FROM snippets', a backfill that is a no-op on an empty database. No judge prompt, criterion or app_context line references /assets, /instructions, a seed record or a fixture file; criteria create their own drafts and app_context.md:23 says 'Do not assume an empty library', so no criterion depends on seed content. tests/test.sh:88 only chmods /assets and is identical to the template. Limitation: the contract table lists solve.sh and criteria as consumers of the seed, but here the seed is intentionally empty, so nothing is left unconsumed. Evidence-index hashes: all 22 artifact hashes recomputed and match. The scripted golden run on these bytes (runtime.json, editor.json, polish.json, persist-before/after.json all true, restart.json showing a record created by the test at revision 2) shows the golden works with no seed-derived data; it is not a configured-judge run and does not measure the agent-image COPY step through the hosted harness.
